描述_EN: this earthenware tomb figure depicts a woman dressed according to han custom with a full-length robe and grasping an object, now lost, in her hands. she probably represents an official of the underworld, buried in the grave to take care of the future needs of the deceased.
描述_ZN: 年：这个陶器墓像描绘了一个按照汉族习俗穿着全身长袍的女人，她的手中抓着一个现在已经丢失的东西。 年¥她可能代表了阴间的官员，被埋在坟墓里以照顾死者未来的需要。
